svg.text: NOTES
Use my location asks the browser. If it
is blocked, offline or insecure, a
readable message and a demo-location
button appear.
Result strip: where the origin came from
and how many workers are within 5 km.
Table sorted by distance from MongoDB
$geoNear (Workflow 3), then joined to
SQL so only available freelancers show.
Choose worker sends the freelancer to
the Fund form. View profile opens Worker
details.
Map section: Open large map shows origin
and workers. The list refreshes every 15
seconds without a reload.

to pan; + and − to zoom; ◎ recentres on
